card.name: Small words before a time or count
card.fires_on: Short linking words or symbols (at, for, time, a hyphen, a digit) that sit right before a time point, duration or number range in clinical text, such as 'at diagnosis' or 'for up to several days'.

modes.label: Preposition before a time point
modes.description: The word 'at' or 'for' comes after a clinical phrase and introduces when something happens or how long it lasts.

modes.label: Inside a number range
modes.description: A hyphen, space or digit within a dose, site count or AUC range.
